case_title: MD. JAMILUDIN NASIR v. STATE OF WEST BENGAL
confession: Yes, confession of A 1 recorded in accordance with s. 164 Cr.PC, sufficient corroboration, relied upon as against co-accused
aggravating_circumstances: Pre-planned attack on police force, resulted in death of five police personnel and grievous injuries to 15 police personnel and civilians, damage to public property, involvement of foreign nationals and terrorist organisation
trial_court_outcome: Convicted A1 to A3, A6 to A9 for offences u/ss. 121A, 121, 122 and ss.302, 307, 333, 467, 471, 46S rw 1208 IPC as also u/ss. 25(1A), 27(2) and 27(3) of Arms Act rw 1208 IPC and were accordingly sentenced to death
high_court_outcome: High Court upheld conviction of A1-appellant 'N' and AS-appellant 'A' as well as the sentence imposed by the trial court on all counts
offence_finally_established: conspiracy, waging of war against the State, murder, grievous hurt, criminal trespass, theft, possession of arms and ammunition
neutral_facts: The accused persons along with other gang members carried out a planned attack on the police force at the American Centre, resulting in the death of five police personnel and injury to around 15 police personnel along with other civilians. The gang members had rehearsed this previously and acquired and possessed arms and ammunition for the same. The complainant, who was working as a sergeant on the date of occurrence, was on night duty and witnessed the incident. Other prosecution witnesses, working there as Inspector and constable, were eye witnesses to the incident. The complainant communicated the incident to the control room of the police. The police team cordoned the premises and suspected the inmates to be militants. They noticed two of the inmates escaped through the side gate shooting at the police and in the cross fire both of them were injured. The injured made an oral dying declaration to a police officer when he was taken to the hospital. He stated that he was the shooter involved in the shooting spree at the American Centre and the other was the driver of the motor bike. The injured died en route the hospital and the other died later. Investigation was carried out. The accused were arrested. The trial court on the basis of the confession of one of the accused, eye witness account of witnesses, oral evidence of prosecution witnesses and various exhibits, convicted the accused for the offences.
